conversation.text: Namaste, main Priyanka Chopra. Mera locker ka access card kho gaya hai.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Namaste Priyanka ji, main aapki madad karoonga. Kya aap apna account number ya locker number bata sakti hain?

conversation.speaker: RM

conversation.speaker: RM
